senses.definition: The basic truths you build an answer up from instead of copying how it is usually done.
distractors: A rule of thumb that gets you a good enough answer quickly.
The underlying layer everything above it runs on and takes for granted.
The direct consequences of a change, before anyone has adapted to it.
